task: Investigate elevated error rates on the checkout API observed over the last 30 minutes.

candidate_memories.content: checkout-api error budget is 0.1% over a 30-min window. When error rate exceeds 0.5%, automatically halt all non-critical deployments and notify the on-call engineer; do not attempt fixes without first establishing a clear root cause hypothesis.
checkout-api error rate at 1.2% for the last 28 min; 4x the error budget. Most errors are 503 from inventory-svc downstream; started immediately after the 14:00 UTC deploy.
inventory-svc circuit breaker status: kubectl get cm circuit-breaker-state -n inventory -o jsonpath='{.data.status}'.
When error spikes correlate with a deploy, the first hypothesis should always be the deploy; have a rollback plan ready before investigating further.
